retrieved_docs: Thomas Johansson | Karl Thomas Conny Johansson (] ; born 24 March 1975 in Linköping), commonly known as Thomas Johansson, is a retired professional tennis player from Sweden.  He reached a career-high Association of Tennis Professionals (ATP) world No. 7 singles ranking on May 10, 2002.  His career highlights in singles include a Grand Slam title at the Australian Open in 2002, and an ATP Masters Series title at the 1999 Canada Masters.  He also won a silver medal at the 2008 Summer Olympics in men's doubles, partnering Simon Aspelin.
